rules.title: Reinsure only with a company licensed to carry the class
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (42): The Company may not reinsure with another company unless the other company is licensed to carry out the insurance type entrusted to reinsure it.
rules.requirement: The counterparty must be licensed for the class of business ceded — a UAE licence, or a home-state licence naming the class for a reinsurer abroad. A UAE carrier may reinsure inside or outside the State, but never with an unlicensed company.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز للشركة أن تعيد التأمين لدى شركة أخرى ما لم تكن تلك الشركة مرخصة لمزاولة نوع التأمين المطلوب إعادة تأمينه.

rules.title: A counterparty at or above the rating floor, or board diligence on file
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (18): acceptance of reinsurance business is conditional on the reinsurer meeting the classification stipulated, and business exceeding retention must be covered with reinsurers who have that classification, subject to the stated exceptions.
rules.requirement: A reinsurance counterparty should hold a financial strength rating of BBB (S&P) or equivalent — Baa2 or better — or, if it does not, the placement needs documented board-level due diligence before it is bound.
rules.requirementAr: يُشترط في شركة إعادة التأمين الحصول على تصنيف مالي لا يقل عن BBB أو ما يعادله، وإلا وجب توثيق العناية الواجبة على مستوى مجلس الإدارة.

rules.title: Recoverables count as admissible assets only at or above the floor
rules.instrument: Minimum capital requirement — CBUAE financial regulations — capital, assets and technical provisions
rules.clause: Assets available to meet insurance liabilities may include reinsurance recoverables where the reinsurer is rated BBB or better.
rules.requirement: Money due from a counterparty below the floor is not an admissible asset: the return must show the recoverable without credit for it, and the solvency position must be read with that in mind.
rules.requirementAr: لا تُعد المبالغ المستحقة من معيد تأمين دون التصنيف المطلوب أصولاً مقبولة، ويجب بيانها دون احتساب رصيد لها.

rules.title: Every cession sits inside the board-approved retention and reinsurance plan
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: The company shall prepare a three-year plan concerning retention and reinsurance for each type and class, approve it at the board, and review it annually during the three months before each year, covering retention and treaty limits, treaty types and facultative cessions.
rules.requirement: A cession must be permitted by the plan the board approved, and the plan must have been reviewed inside the year before the placement. A cession outside the plan is refused; a plan whose review window has passed is escalated.
rules.requirementAr: يجب أن تكون إعادة التأمين ضمن الخطة المعتمدة من مجلس الإدارة، وأن تُراجع الخطة سنوياً خلال الأشهر الثلاثة السابقة لكل سنة.
evidence: board minute of the annual review

rules.title: A foreign branch files its head-office reinsurance certificate every year
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: A foreign insurance company operating in the State through a branch shall annually submit a certified certificate from its head office supporting that the business subscribed within the State and exceeding its retention is covered by reinsurance with reinsurers who have the classification stipulated in Article (18).
rules.requirement: Where the counterparty is the branch of a foreign company, its annual certified certificate must be on file and no more than twelve months old.
rules.requirementAr: على فرع شركة التأمين الأجنبية العاملة في الدولة أن يقدم سنوياً شهادة معتمدة من المركز الرئيسي تفيد بأن الأعمال التي تتجاوز حد الاحتفاظ مغطاة لدى معيدي تأمين حاصلين على التصنيف المطلوب.

rules.title: Accepting treaty reinsurance needs approval and capital
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (39): in order to accept the treaty reinsurance business, the insurance company established in the State is required to obtain approval from the Director General, and the minimum subscribed and paid-up capital of the company shall not be less than AED 350,000,000.
rules.requirement: Inward treaty business may only be accepted with the Director General's approval, articles that authorise accepting reinsurance, and at least AED 350,000,000 of subscribed and paid-up capital.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز قبول أعمال إعادة التأمين الاتفاقي إلا بعد الحصول على موافقة المدير العام، وبألا يقل رأس المال المكتتب المدفوع عن 350,000,000 درهم.

rules.title: Facultative acceptance only within retention or under a treaty
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (38): the accepted liabilities shall be either within the company's retention or exceeding it, in which case the company must have a reinsurance treaty that protects the surplus and contains a provision allowing it to accept facultative reinsurance within determined limits; re-ceding that surplus facultatively needs the prior approval of the ceding company.
rules.requirement: Facultative business may be accepted only inside the retention or under a treaty that protects the surplus and permits facultative acceptance; passing the surplus on needs the ceding company's prior approval.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز قبول أعمال إعادة التأمين الاختياري إلا في حدود حد الاحتفاظ أو في وجود اتفاقية تحمي الفائض وتجيز القبول، مع الحصول على موافقة مسبقة من الشركة المتنازلة عند إعادة التنازل.

rules.title: A tender is only offered with a leading reinsurer behind the surplus
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (31): the company shall obtain approval, before submitting its offer, from a leading reinsurer that meets the conditions stipulated in Article (18), where the tender's cover is one for which the company has no reinsurance treaty covering the surplus above its retention.
rules.requirement: Where a tender is not covered by treaty, written approval from a leading reinsurer that meets the classification requirement must be on file before the offer goes in.
rules.requirementAr: يجب الحصول على موافقة من معيد تأمين رائد يستوفي شروط المادة (18) قبل تقديم العرض إذا لم تكن تغطية المناقصة مشمولة باتفاقية إعادة تأمين.

rules.title: Participant risk money goes to retakaful only
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (42), read with the takaful regulations: the class entrusted must be carried by the counterparty, and a takaful operator's participant risk fund may only be protected by retakaful.
rules.requirement: A takaful window cedes only to a retakaful operator or a Shariah-compliant retakaful window. Participant risk money never enters a conventional pool — a breach is refused at the register, not corrected afterwards.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز لصندوق مخاطر المشتركين في شركة تكافل أن يعيد التأمين إلا لدى معيد تكافل، ولا يجوز تحويل أموال المخاطر للمشتركين إلى صندوق تقليدي.

rules.title: A free-zone company reinsures, and does nothing else outside the zone
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (64): insurance companies licensed to operate in the financial free zones may not carry out any activity outside such zones in the State, except for reinsurance.
rules.requirement: A free-zone counterparty is a permitted reinsurer: the placement may stand, and the decision records the limit on what that company may do outside its zone.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز لشركات التأمين المرخصة في المناطق المالية الحرة مزاولة أي نشاط خارج تلك المناطق داخل الدولة، باستثناء إعادة التأمين.

rules.title: A foreign branch lodges the bank guarantee its licence requires
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026

rules.title: Reinsure only with a company licensed to carry the class
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (42): The Company may not reinsure with another company unless the other company is licensed to carry out the insurance type entrusted to reinsure it.
rules.requirement: The counterparty must be licensed for the class of business ceded — a UAE licence, or a home-state licence naming the class for a reinsurer abroad. A UAE carrier may reinsure inside or outside the State, but never with an unlicensed company.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز للشركة أن تعيد التأمين لدى شركة أخرى ما لم تكن تلك الشركة مرخصة لمزاولة نوع التأمين المطلوب إعادة تأمينه.

rules.title: A counterparty at or above the rating floor, or board diligence on file
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (18): acceptance of reinsurance business is conditional on the reinsurer meeting the classification stipulated, and business exceeding retention must be covered with reinsurers who have that classification, subject to the stated exceptions.
rules.requirement: A reinsurance counterparty should hold a financial strength rating of BBB (S&P) or equivalent — Baa2 or better — or, if it does not, the placement needs documented board-level due diligence before it is bound.
rules.requirementAr: يُشترط في شركة إعادة التأمين الحصول على تصنيف مالي لا يقل عن BBB أو ما يعادله، وإلا وجب توثيق العناية الواجبة على مستوى مجلس الإدارة.

rules.title: Recoverables count as admissible assets only at or above the floor
rules.instrument: Minimum capital requirement — CBUAE financial regulations — capital, assets and technical provisions
rules.clause: Assets available to meet insurance liabilities may include reinsurance recoverables where the reinsurer is rated BBB or better.
rules.requirement: Money due from a counterparty below the floor is not an admissible asset: the return must show the recoverable without credit for it, and the solvency position must be read with that in mind.
rules.requirementAr: لا تُعد المبالغ المستحقة من معيد تأمين دون التصنيف المطلوب أصولاً مقبولة، ويجب بيانها دون احتساب رصيد لها.

rules.title: Every cession sits inside the board-approved retention and reinsurance plan
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: The company shall prepare a three-year plan concerning retention and reinsurance for each type and class, approve it at the board, and review it annually during the three months before each year, covering retention and treaty limits, treaty types and facultative cessions.
rules.requirement: A cession must be permitted by the plan the board approved, and the plan must have been reviewed inside the year before the placement. A cession outside the plan is refused; a plan whose review window has passed is escalated.
rules.requirementAr: يجب أن تكون إعادة التأمين ضمن الخطة المعتمدة من مجلس الإدارة، وأن تُراجع الخطة سنوياً خلال الأشهر الثلاثة السابقة لكل سنة.
evidence: board minute of the annual review

rules.title: A foreign branch files its head-office reinsurance certificate every year
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: A foreign insurance company operating in the State through a branch shall annually submit a certified certificate from its head office supporting that the business subscribed within the State and exceeding its retention is covered by reinsurance with reinsurers who have the classification stipulated in Article (18).
rules.requirement: Where the counterparty is the branch of a foreign company, its annual certified certificate must be on file and no more than twelve months old.
rules.requirementAr: على فرع شركة التأمين الأجنبية العاملة في الدولة أن يقدم سنوياً شهادة معتمدة من المركز الرئيسي تفيد بأن الأعمال التي تتجاوز حد الاحتفاظ مغطاة لدى معيدي تأمين حاصلين على التصنيف المطلوب.

rules.title: Accepting treaty reinsurance needs approval and capital
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (39): in order to accept the treaty reinsurance business, the insurance company established in the State is required to obtain approval from the Director General, and the minimum subscribed and paid-up capital of the company shall not be less than AED 350,000,000.
rules.requirement: Inward treaty business may only be accepted with the Director General's approval, articles that authorise accepting reinsurance, and at least AED 350,000,000 of subscribed and paid-up capital.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز قبول أعمال إعادة التأمين الاتفاقي إلا بعد الحصول على موافقة المدير العام، وبألا يقل رأس المال المكتتب المدفوع عن 350,000,000 درهم.

rules.title: Facultative acceptance only within retention or under a treaty
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (38): the accepted liabilities shall be either within the company's retention or exceeding it, in which case the company must have a reinsurance treaty that protects the surplus and contains a provision allowing it to accept facultative reinsurance within determined limits; re-ceding that surplus facultatively needs the prior approval of the ceding company.
rules.requirement: Facultative business may be accepted only inside the retention or under a treaty that protects the surplus and permits facultative acceptance; passing the surplus on needs the ceding company's prior approval.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز قبول أعمال إعادة التأمين الاختياري إلا في حدود حد الاحتفاظ أو في وجود اتفاقية تحمي الفائض وتجيز القبول، مع الحصول على موافقة مسبقة من الشركة المتنازلة عند إعادة التنازل.

rules.title: A tender is only offered with a leading reinsurer behind the surplus
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (31): the company shall obtain approval, before submitting its offer, from a leading reinsurer that meets the conditions stipulated in Article (18), where the tender's cover is one for which the company has no reinsurance treaty covering the surplus above its retention.
rules.requirement: Where a tender is not covered by treaty, written approval from a leading reinsurer that meets the classification requirement must be on file before the offer goes in.
rules.requirementAr: يجب الحصول على موافقة من معيد تأمين رائد يستوفي شروط المادة (18) قبل تقديم العرض إذا لم تكن تغطية المناقصة مشمولة باتفاقية إعادة تأمين.

rules.title: Participant risk money goes to retakaful only
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (42), read with the takaful regulations: the class entrusted must be carried by the counterparty, and a takaful operator's participant risk fund may only be protected by retakaful.
rules.requirement: A takaful window cedes only to a retakaful operator or a Shariah-compliant retakaful window. Participant risk money never enters a conventional pool — a breach is refused at the register, not corrected afterwards.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز لصندوق مخاطر المشتركين في شركة تكافل أن يعيد التأمين إلا لدى معيد تكافل، ولا يجوز تحويل أموال المخاطر للمشتركين إلى صندوق تقليدي.

rules.title: A free-zone company reinsures, and does nothing else outside the zone
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (64): insurance companies licensed to operate in the financial free zones may not carry out any activity outside such zones in the State, except for reinsurance.
rules.requirement: A free-zone counterparty is a permitted reinsurer: the placement may stand, and the decision records the limit on what that company may do outside its zone.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز لشركات التأمين المرخصة في المناطق المالية الحرة مزاولة أي نشاط خارج تلك المناطق داخل الدولة، باستثناء إعادة التأمين.

rules.title: A foreign branch lodges the bank guarantee its licence requires
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (50): the foreign insurance company's branch shall submit an irrevocable bank guarantee in favour of the CBUAE of not less than AED 100,000,000 where it carries on insurance activity, and not less than AED 250,000,000 where it carries on reinsurance activity.
rules.requirement: Where the counterparty is a foreign branch writing reinsurance, an irrevocable bank guarantee of at least AED 250,000,000 (AED 100,000,000 for insurance) must be lodged with the CBUAE.
rules.requirementAr: يقدم فرع شركة التأمين الأجنبية ضماناً مصرفياً غير قابل للإلغاء لصالح المصرف المركزي لا يقل عن 100,000,000 درهم لمزاولة التأمين و250,000,000 درهم لمزاولة إعادة التأمين.

rules.title: UAE risk insured at home, protected anywhere
rules.instrument: Article (82) — Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 on the Central Bank, the Regulation of Financial Institutions and Activities, and Insurance Business
rules.note: consolidates the insurance law into the CBUAE mandate; the reinsurance freedoms and controls of the 2023 law are carried forward
